# HK Engimech

> HK Engimech is a premier manufacturer and service provider of industrial packaging solutions, including wooden pallets, corrugated boxes, shrink wrapping, and container lashing, based in Vadodara, Gujarat.

Important notes:
- Official site: https://hkengimech.com
- Primary services/products: Industrial Packaging, Shrink Wrapping, Tarpaulin Packaging, Wooden Boxes, Plywood Boxes, Pallets, Corrugated Packaging, Container Lashing, Vacuum & VCI Packaging
- Primary location/service area: Vadodara, Gujarat, India
- Contact: https://hkengimech.com/contactUs.html
